thread:
nina: Morning team — partner billing flagged an unusual refund batch from Azure Marketplace. Can someone check if this is related to last night's pricing experiment?

reza: Looking now. The refund rows show an extra `partner_commission_adj` line inserted after invoice finalization. Seems correlated with experiment toggle `az_pricing_v2` flipping at 02:00 UTC.

sam: Example (redacted):
```
invoice: 77421 | partner: summitcloud | charge: 2400.00 | commission: -360.00 | commission_adj: -360.00 | net: 1680.00
```
That `commission_adj` is the duplicate.

nina: Oof. Partners will see half-payments if we don't reconcile. Reza, can you list affected invoices and total liability?

reza: Quick scan: 29 invoices affected, aggregate extra credits ~ $10,440. Uploaded CSV: https://drive.redwood/finance/az-refund-dup-2001234567.csv (cols: invoice_id, partner_id, extra_credit_usd, contact).

accounts-bot: Notification: payment-hold applied to impacted partners per request from nina. hold_id: ph_2001234567.

sam: Engineering should revert the experiment flag and run a recompute. Finance — do we OK automated ledger reversals once recompute finishes? Cap requires manual sign-off > $2k per partner.

nina: Approve recompute and automated reversals for amounts <= $2k. For any partner where extra_credit > $2k, I'll review case-by-case. Also draft a short comms note to partners and cc Partner Ops.

reza: I'll open the rollback PR and schedule recompute for invoices created between 2026-03-31 01:45 - 02:15 UTC. ETA for job: 18m.

sam: Heads-up — create an incident ticket so Support and Partner Ops can track outreach. I'll add it to the partner-ops queue.

nina: Thanks. Keep updates here only. Post when recompute completes and when reversals hit ledger.

accounts-bot: Job queued: invoice-recompute-2001234567 by reza. estimated_time: 18m.
